deepseek.cache: Observed provider cache hit/miss counts; predominantly short uncached prompts.
deepseek.request_admission: Preserve maximum input/output reservation and all existing attempt histories.

lambda.comparable_model_fit: Prior official recipe requires about 960GB weights; planning allocation 8xB200 180GB. A cheap single GPU does not fit this model. Public checkpoint equivalence to hosted0813 has not been established.
lambda.other_costs: Prefill, qualification, idle and shutdown time would increase GPU cost. Included local SSD is sufficient for these tiny prompts; no separate persistent storage is needed. No instance or filesystem is allocated. Any future allocation must be terminated and verified.
lambda.batching: No qualified warm endpoint or measured saturated throughput exists for this continuation.

local_storage.reason: Small text records; native-file executor remains stopped after its separate ENOSPC failure.

decision: Continue DeepSeek: approximately one dollar of expected weekend API inference versus at least $26.76 assumed comparable cold GPU loading before decoding. Keep prompt/model/inputs fixed. No GPU rented. Revisit if workload, measured throughput, model capability or prices change.
